scientific_limitations_and_integrity: Index-cutoff asymptotic for exactly two Zeckendorf summands and fixed dyadic moduli with exponent at least five; no value-size cutoff or general modulus statement. Known weight-two aggregate 5/9 is not claimed new; no independent audit; incomplete access to Ray–Cooper (2006).
title: A uniform 32-class dyadic bias law for two-summand Zeckendorf–Niven numbers
